title: Biduality of a lisse Weil sheaf
statement:
Let $k_0$ be a finite field, $k$ an algebraic closure of $k_0$, $\ell\ne\operatorname{char}(k_0)$ a prime, and $\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$ an algebraic closure of $\mathbf Q_\ell$ (Lean `PadicAlgCl ℓ`). Let $X$ be any $k_0$-scheme and put $\bar X=X\times_{k_0}k$. Use the small pro-etale site of $\bar X$ [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site], with the universes of [def-weil-size-convention]. Let $R=\overline{\mathbf Q}_{\ell,\bar X}$ be the adic coefficient ring sheaf: on an object $U$ its sections are continuous functions $U\to\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$ whose values, locally on $U$, span a finite-dimensional $\mathbf Q_\ell$-subspace, with pointwise ring operations and restriction by precomposition (Lean `ProEtale.adicConstantSheaf`). Let $g=\operatorname{id}_X\times\operatorname{Spec}(\gamma)$, where $\gamma$ is inverse to $z\mapsto z^{\#k_0}$ on $k$, and let $T=(g^{-1})_*$ on $R$-module sheaves [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], with coefficients identified by pullback of functions. Thus $T$ is Frobenius pullback, realized by reindexing along an automorphism.

Let $P=(M,\theta:TM\xrightarrow{\sim}M)$ be a lisse Weil sheaf (Lean `WeilSheaf k₀ ℓ X`, `P.IsLisse`): $M$ is pro-etale locally a finite direct sum of copies of $R$, with ranks allowed to vary. Weil morphisms are morphisms of fixed pairs [def-weil-endofunctor-fixed-pair-category]. Put $D(M)=\mathcal Hom_R(M,R)$ [def-pur-sheaf-hom]. The Weil dual $P^\vee$ has underlying module $D(M)$ and structure $TD(M)\cong\mathcal Hom_{TR}(TM,TR)\xrightarrow{\sim}D(M)$ given by precomposition with $\theta^{-1}$ and the coefficient identification $TR\cong R$ (Lean `WeilSheaf.dual`). This dual is again lisse. Then $P$ is isomorphic, as a Weil sheaf, to $(P^\vee)^\vee$.
